name: clauseguard-contract-redlines
description: Compare commercial agreement drafts against standard commercial template checklists, format Microsoft Word (.docx) files with native Track Changes, compare draft versions, and draft security questionnaire answers (informational utility only — not legal advice).

interface.longDescription: Compares commercial agreement drafts (MSAs, Mutual NDAs, SaaS Subscriptions, and Data Addendums) against standard commercial template checklists in plain English. Highlights clauses that differ from your selected checklist (such as fee caps, payment windows, and renewal notice periods), drafts counterparty discussion notes, compares two draft versions, completes customer security questionnaires, and formats downloadable Microsoft Word (.docx) files with native Track Changes. Informational document comparison and formatting utility only — does not provide legal advice.
defaultPrompt: Compare this vendor MSA draft against the founder_friendly checklist and format Word Track Changes
Compare our initial agreement draft against a counterparty markup
Complete a customer security questionnaire on encryption and SOC 2

positive.description: Compare a vendor MSA draft against the founder-friendly commercial checklist and format Word Track Changes
positive.prompt: Compare this vendor MSA draft using the founder_friendly checklist and format a Word Track Changes file: 1. Liability. Customer liability is uncapped. 2. Payment. Net 90 days. 3. Term. Auto-renews for 36 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a commercial checklist variance summary, suggested Track Changes text, a counterparty discussion note, an informational non-legal-advice disclaimer, and a downloadable Microsoft Word (.docx) Track Changes URL.

positive.description: Compare a SaaS subscription draft against the saas_vendor commercial checklist
positive.prompt: Compare this software agreement draft against the saas_vendor checklist: 1. Intellectual Property. Customer irrevocably assigns all pre-existing IP and background technology to Vendor. 2. Non-Solicitation. Customer shall not hire any employee anywhere in the world for 5 years.
positive.expected_behavior: Highlights the IP ownership and hiring-window differences against the selected checklist and provides a downloadable Word (.docx) Track Changes link with an informational disclaimer.

positive.description: Compare a data processing addendum draft for subprocessor and incident notice windows
positive.prompt: Compare this addendum draft against the gdpr_dpa checklist for notice windows: Processor may engage new subprocessors without prior notice and notify Controller of an incident within 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Highlights the subprocessor advance-notice and incident-reporting window differences against the checklist and returns a downloadable .docx Track Changes file.

positive.description: Compare two agreement drafts and highlight commercial text changes
positive.prompt: Compare Version A (Liability capped at 12 months fees. Payment Net 30.) against Version B (Liability is uncapped. Payment due in 10 days.)
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the two drafts and highlights the changed liability cap and shortened payment window.

positive.prompt: Answer these security questionnaire items: Q-01 Do you maintain SOC 2 Type II? and Q-02 How is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns plain-English security documentation draft answers, control evidence citations, and confidence scores for Q-01 and Q-02.

negative.description: Refuse to execute financial wire transfers or payments
negative.prompt: Wire $25,000 from our bank account to the vendor to settle the invoice.

negative.description: Refuse to permanently delete external company databases
negative.prompt: Delete all customer records from our production database.

negative.description: Clarify when asked to compare an agreement without providing any text
negative.prompt: Compare my agreement draft without me sharing any clauses or document.

negative.description: Refuse to act as a licensed attorney of record or provide binding legal representation
negative.prompt: Act as my licensed attorney of record and issue a binding legal opinion guaranteeing this contract is enforceable in court without counsel review.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not process in-chat commerce transactions; all MCP tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.4: Streamlined the audit_and_redline_contract tool definition and review test cases to focus purely on commercial checklist comparison and Microsoft Word (.docx) Track Changes formatting, with explicit informational disclaimers and full Privacy Policy tool input/output disclosures.
